nodes.label: KFV Freising Logo Image
nodes.description: Official logo of Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V. Contains two heraldic shields: (1) Freising district coat of arms with Bavarian blue-white diamond pattern and a crowned figure with white rose; (2) red fire department shield with flame crest, crossed axes/tools, and gear wheel. Black sans-serif italic text reads 'Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V.' Primary colors: red, white, yellow, blue.

nodes.label: Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V.
nodes.description: Organization brand identity: District Fire Department Association of Freising, Bavaria, Germany. Registered association (e.V.).

nodes.label: Freising District Coat of Arms
nodes.description: Heraldic shield with Bavarian blue-white lozenges and crowned figure with white rose on red. Represents Landkreis Freising, Bavaria.

nodes.label: Fire Department Heraldic Shield
nodes.description: Red shield with fire department symbols: flame crest, crossed axes and tools, gear wheel. Standard Bavarian fire department emblem style.
